## Per model and readout (median over datasets)

Entrance = sustained 5% tunnel entrance on VALIDATION loss, relative to that readout's own final block (so read it with the final-block loss). `same / within 1 / within 2` counts datasets whose entrance matches the native one exactly, within one block, within two. Final change = test loss at the final block vs the native readout; `worse / better / inconclusive` uses the paired 95% CI. rho = median Spearman correlation of the validation curve with the native one.

## Fixed limitations (stated independently of the outcome)

* Readout-structure confound: for Chronos-2 and TiRex the content-mean readout also changes the head (one vector to the whole horizon, no patch-wise sharing, 4x and 2x the native parameters). TimesFM-3 is the controlled case (same head, same parameters); the native-mean control isolates token selection with the head fixed.
* An earlier entrance can come from a weaker final block; entrances are never read without the final-block losses.
* Losses are comparable across readouts within a model (same windows, same normalized targets) but not across models.
* One probe fit per depth and readout (the Phase-1 protocol, seed 0, weight decay chosen on validation); variation across seeds is not measured.
